label: bluegecko-3v1-comet-catcher-7
people: [gecko]u6bkep (lobby 19.24, Armada), the opponent; spectating and advising in chat: thebluegecko (bot.log 'player 1') and Infern8 (lobby 25, 'player 2'), names per docs/briefs/lessons.md (chat.jsonl has speaker '?' for every line)
our_side: Three seats on the east strip, all Cortex (side Random): purple t1 at G1 (ai 0, record-0), dark blue t2 at H8 (ai 1), teal t3 at G4 (ai 2). One player, Opus 5.5 medium (Claude Code 2.1.283), over all three seats; hands Jev jev-latest = jev-1.13.0, one per seat; realtime; no commander layer.
build: b9bd34e (2026-09-26; the players' advice block H-PLAYER-PLAYERS-ADVICE in its first game)
summary: Three Cortex seats under one Opus 5.5 medium player beat u6bkep (Armada, lobby 19), with thebluegecko and Infern8 advising in chat. His commander died at 13:59 at B4 when all three groups attacked together (sent at 13:00), and both his plants fell by 14:08. He played one vehicle plant and only Blitzes until 10:35. They raided our strip from 4:23 (18 of our extractors in all) and killed teal's commander at home at 6:12, but about 46 Blitzes died doing it, and from 7:00 he had almost no army against our 5.8k. The first attack on his base, ordered at 7:00, arrived as a single group of Incisors after a 54-s stall at C1, and his commander D-gunned 11 of them. Then the player held for three minutes, banked 3.4k and began an advanced plant that was never finished; meanwhile he rebuilt with Stouts and Janus, which beat our groups one at a time at C5 (11:04-11:53).

root.what: The game never lost the lead (seen floors only); the root is where the quick close was given up. At 7:00 his Blitz army was spent (the player's note: ~40 killed, his commander at B4 with 3 constructors), and the player ordered group_A_t1 and group_A_t2 to advance 'together' and attack_unit the commander. The two groups started from C1 and G6, about 5,900 apart. group_A_t1 (24 Incisors, just out of a 54-s stall at C1) reached B4 alone at 7:50 while group_A_t2 was still at E5. His commander D-gunned 11 of the 16 Incisors lost, and the fall-back at 7:58 walked the rest 3,845 back to F2. The next attack that arrived together (sent 13:00) killed him within a minute. Our reading; thebluegecko named the stall at 7:26.
root.evidence: hands_window seat 0 7:54 'group_A_t1: 22 at (2032, 2201), task fight_to enemy_plant'; seat 1 7:55 'group_A_t2: 23 at (4305, 3570)'; minutes 'corgator_7580 ... died 7:57 at B4 to armcom'; analyze #4 7:18-8:11 B4 'we lost 1920 ({'corgator': 16})'

their_play: u6bkep (Armada, lobby 19) ran one vehicle plant at B4 (seen 3:12) and kept his commander home all game. He built only Blitzes until 10:35 and raided our east strip in bands of 2-10 from 4:23: 18 of our extractors died, all to armflash (10 in 4:27-5:52, 8 in 9:33-10:47), and 8-9 Blitzes killed teal's commander at G4 at 6:12. About 46 Blitzes died doing it, and his army in sight was 0 at 7:00 and 9:00 (floors). His commander D-gunned 11 Incisors at B4 from 7:49 to 8:11. He then added a second vehicle plant, a radar (9:14), a beam turret at B8 (9:54), Stouts (first seen 10:35) and Janus (10:54). That party beat our groups at C5 from 11:04 to 12:18; 28 Stouts and 11 Janus died in all. No tier 2 was seen. thebluegecko at 5:01: 'the human player is taking mexes so much faster that 3v1 is about fair'. His extractor count is unknown (no truth file; 5-8 seen).

bears_on.id: L-mex-half-the-map
bears_on.note: The lesson's source game (thebluegecko 5:01-6:34). We held 23 extractors at 5:09, and the team's grew to 44 by 9:20. Applying 'hold half the map while raiding the corners' at 5:35 turned the advancing group into the C1 stall.

bears_on.id: L-raid-keep-moving
bears_on.note: The north raid stood 54 s at C1 (6:19-7:13). By the time it reached B4 (7:50) his commander was home and D-gunned it. The 8:42 'south has unprotected mexes' raid killed 6 extractors (the 9:20 note).

bears_on.id: L-raid-naked-mexes
bears_on.note: His bare southern extractors were raided at 8:53 on thebluegecko's word; 6 died (the 9:20 note).

bears_on.id: L-snipe-commander
bears_on.note: Incisors that came at his commander one by one lost 16 (11 to the D-gun) at 7:49-8:11; three groups together killed it at 13:59, though 13 Brutes died in its death blast.

bears_on.id: L-lead-use-it
bears_on.note: From 7:00 his army in sight was near zero against 5.8k. The three-minute hold (7:57-10:47) let him rebuild with Stouts and Janus, and the close came only at 13:59.

bears_on.id: L-lead-together
bears_on.note: Split arrivals cost us at 7:50 (A_t1 alone, A_t2 at E5) and at C5 11:04-11:53 (t2, then t1); the gathered push from spot_43 at 13:00 won within a minute.

bears_on.id: L-other-infern8-transition
bears_on.note: The lesson's source (13:05, 13:40). It came while purple's advanced plant was 45% built with one constructor, and that plant never finished.

bears_on.id: L-tier2-tier1-under-tier2
bears_on.note: Purple's advanced plant drew from a store at 0-69 beside two tier-1 plants still producing; it never finished, and the game was won on tier 1.

bears_on.note: Our player announced its state and plans in chat ('23 extractors, 11 constructors' 5:09; 'Sending our 22-Incisor group south' 8:53). Whether the opponent could read it is unknown.

bears_on.id: Going and the lead: a lead decays, one body from a gathering place, arrive together, the ball's return home, only the army wins
bears_on.note: The root: the 7:00 attack arrived split and fed a D-gun, while the 13:00 attack from one gathering place (spot_43) won. The fall-back home rule cost Incisors at 7:58.

bears_on.id: Pressure from the first units: the first handful crosses the map
bears_on.note: First soldiers came at 2:12-2:32 (pool p75 1:49) and none crossed before 5:31. thebluegecko at 5:01: the person was out-expanding our three seats.

bears_on.id: The raid answer: who answers a raider, pickets, the turret with the spot, the 600 rule

bears_on.note: Odds without the D-gun, death blast or reach cost Incisors at 7:54, the C5 fight and 13 Brutes at 13:59 (fixed 2026-09-26/27).

bears_on.note: Teal's commander died at home with its group sent west and no D-gun. His commander stayed home and D-gunned 11 Incisors.

bears_on.id: The bank and build power: what a bank means, what spends it first, build power on frames
bears_on.note: The bank reached 3.4k at 9:20 (seat 0 above 500 in minutes 8-11). thebluegecko at 8:01 asked for build power, but the construction turrets then starved the plants of energy.

bears_on.id: Energy in the opening: solars before and with the plant, the metal-bound first four minutes, the solar rule, the commander on the plant

bears_on.note: A tier-2 start at 9:20 in a 3v1 with his army gone bought nothing: the plant was unfinished at 14:11. Infern8's feeding advice came at 13:05.

bears_on.id: Ahead on the trade and lost: the 3v1 pattern
bears_on.note: The contrasting case: a 3v1 ahead on the trade that was won, because the three groups finally arrived together at his base. The player's trade lines were summed across seats (24.7k corrected).

tools: direct reads of record-0/1/2 (enemy first sightings, armcom and corcom deaths), bot.log, strategist-0.jsonl
lens.existing_review: none (no review.md; 00/posing-review.md and 00/decompression-review.md read and built on)
lens.caveats: No truth file, results.jsonl or batch.json, so his numbers are what we saw. analyze_match, minutes, floor, raid_ledger, pro_baseline and hands_window read only record-0 (seat 0, purple); seats 1 and 2 were read through scratch directories of symlinks. pro_baseline needed --all-starts and compares each seat, a third of a 3v1, against 1v1 duels. raid_ledger's answer column reads 'none' where jev-0 shows group plays (posing review). There is no review.md, but 00/posing-review.md and 00/decompression-review.md exist; I build on the posing review's findings and rank by root, not cost. I differ from the ledger, which takes the 14:11 end as his resignation: the record has his commander destroyed at 13:59 (u 18880 at (1641, 2707)). chat.jsonl speakers are '?'; names come from bot.log player ids and lessons.md. One player session was replaced mid-game (impedance_sweep) with no visible cost.

open_questions: Did the game end on the commander kill at 13:59 (commander ends) or on his disconnect at 14:11? The record has armcom destroyed at 13:59, and both plants died 14:01-14:08.
How many extractors did he hold at 5:00? thebluegecko said he out-expanded three seats ('3v1 is about fair'); with no truth file, only 5-8 were seen.
Could the opponent read our player's chat (our extractor count at 5:09, the corner raid at 5:42, 'Sending our 22-Incisor group south' at 8:53)? The record does not give the chat's audience.
Why did group_A_t1 stand at C1 from 6:19 to 7:13 with fight_to spot_9 and no party in the picture: terrain (the player's reading) or pathing into the north corner?
Would the 15 Incisors at C3 at 5:43 have done better at his base than the 24 that arrived at 7:50? His commander was home both times.
